Next, CA Question 15.
Across multiple branches of First Bank of Nigeria Limited, analysts noted that inconsistent internet connectivity disrupted access to centralised customer systems.
Which IT management challenge BEST explains this situation?
Option A.
Infrastructural instability involving unreliable communication network availability.
Option B.
Organisational resistance caused by inadequate employee motivation strategies.
Option C.
Strategic misalignment involving poor customer acquisition planning decisions.
Option D.
Governance complexity involving overlapping software licensing agreements.
The suggested answer is A.
Unreliable connectivity is infrastructure instability.
Now, CA Question 16.

Amid increasing digital competition across Nigerian banking platforms, executives at Guaranty Trust Holding Company Plc, known as GTCO, proposed integrating predictive analytics into customer service channels.
Which IT management principle is MOST directly demonstrated by this initiative?
Option A.
Strategic alignment through technology-enabled customer experience innovation.
Option B.
Resource allocation through workforce restructuring and procurement controls.
Option C.
Performance measurement through operational dashboards and reporting controls.
Option D.
Risk mitigation through compliance enforcement and infrastructure monitoring.
The suggested answer is A.
Predictive analytics supports the business objective of improved customer experience.
Moving on to CA Question 17.

Following operational failures caused by weak technology governance at an African Development Bank Group, or AfDB, regional project office, consultants emphasised that IT should never function as a peripheral support tool.
This conclusion reinforces the principle that technology must: Option A.
Serve as an integrated component of organisational business strategy execution.
Option B.
Operate independently from enterprise strategic planning activities and priorities.
Option C.
Focus primarily on reducing infrastructure procurement and staffing expenses.
Option D.
Remain isolated from customer engagement and operational transformation goals.
The suggested answer is A.
IT must support organisational strategy rather than operate in isolation.
Next, CA Question 19.
After cloud cost overruns affected operational budgets at Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu Limited, governance teams introduced dashboards tracking system uptime, customer complaints, and deployment delays.
Which principle is being implemented MOST directly?
Option A.
Performance measurement through Key Performance Indicators, or KPIs, analysis.
Option B.
Resource optimisation through hybrid workforce restructuring initiatives.
Option C.
Infrastructure governance through centralised database administration controls.
Option D.
Strategic alignment through enterprise digital transformation initiatives.
The suggested answer is A.
Uptime, complaints and deployment delays are performance indicators.
